info.name: Returns matched addresses within a bounding box.

params.name: bbox
params.description: A pair of comma-separated coordinates with an accuracy of two decimal places or less, that specify the lower left and upper right coordinates of the bounding box. The maximum size of the bounding box is 1 km2. If the bounding box exceeds this, an error message is returned. The precision of the coordinates is to an accuracy of 8 metres.

params.name: format
params.description: The format the response will be returned in. Default: JSON.

params.name: maxresults
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the list of returned results by this amount.

params.name: dataset
params.description: The dataset to return. Multiple values can be sent, separated by a comma. Default: DPA.

params.name: lr
params.description: Which language of addresses to return. Default: EN, CY.

params.name: output_srs
params.description: The intended output spatial reference system. Default: EPSG:27700

params.name: srs
params.description: The spatial reference system for the input coordinate set.

params.name: fq
params.description: Filter for classification code, logical status code, LPI logical status code and/or country code. Filtering for classification code will accept wildcard ( * ) searches. Multiple searches can be done by separating the codes with a space. Multiple filters can be used together by including the parameter multiple times
